messages:
jamie.marketing: Quick brainstorm — want to run a compact PLG experiment tied to the launch posts + a small benchmark narrative for the webinar. Goal: bump 7-day activation by 6-8% using a mix of free credits, prompt templates, and an inbound routing tweak. Thoughts?

sam.growth: love it. concise experiment -> 3 arms? baseline (current credits), credit + prompt templates, credit + templates + proactive nudge flow.

annie.content: we can craft 2 launch post variants to A/B: Variant A focuses on 'jumpstart templates' (Jira, sales email, blog outline). Variant B focuses on 'credits to explore' + benchmark callout ("80% of test apps reduced prompt tokens"). short social copy + one hero screenshot each.

leo.ops: routing note: for webinar signups we should tag source=webinar in Segment and route to 'seed-credit' cohort. I can add a Segment rule: if signup.campaign == 'ignite-launch' -> trait:plg_seed = true. anyone object?

maria.rs: no objection. add a quick eval harness to track model cost per active user. We'll capture avg tokens, latency, and quality pass rate on demo prompts.

jamie.marketing: timeline proposal: creative + landing by Tue, rollout Wed, run 1 week, analyze after 10 days. Targets: CVR to first API call + 7-day activation.

sam.growth: metrics and instrumentation: funnel events = signup -> first_prompt -> first_completion_success -> 7d_active. I'll add experiment flags and track cohort in Amplitude.

annie.content: copy ideas (two short options):
- Variant A: "Get $20 credits + ready-to-use prompt packs — ship LLM features faster."
- Variant B: "See our benchmark: same latency, 30% lower token cost. Try with $20 credits."

leo.ops: routing snippet I’ll add to Segment: 
```
if (event.source === 'webinar' && event.campaign === 'ignite-launch') {
  analytics.identify(userId, { plg_seed: true });
  analytics.track('seed_cohort_assigned', { cohort: 'ignite-seed' });
}
```

sam.growth: nudge flow (for arm 3): Day0: welcome + 20 credits + 3 prompt templates. Day2: short tip + example of 1-min win. Day5: invite to 15m office hours + benchmark snapshot. Keep messages short. Use in-product toast for first_prompt nudge.

annie.content: webinar mention in posts: tease a "benchmark minutes" segment where we show cost vs latency on typical tasks. CTA -> try prompt pack + claim credits.

maria.rs: eval prompt set (sample): "summarize meeting notes", "convert spec into tasks", "rewrite sales outreach" — small but representative. We'll run them on the onboarding prompts to measure quality regressions.

jamie.marketing: owners: creative = annie, routing = leo, instrumentation = sam, evals = maria. jamie to coordinate calendar + launch-bot to post reminder.

launch-bot: Reminder scheduled: "ignite launch experiment kickoff" on 2025-06-11 09:00 UTC. :calendar:

sam.growth: quick ask to eng on throttles — can we set a soft token limit on seed cohort to avoid cost spikes? @leo.ops can you confirm infra?

leo.ops: yes — set per-org token cap 50k/day for seed cohort, with alert above 60%. I’ll add runbook snippets.

annie.content: i'll draft both post variants and a 30s hero video mock. sharing drafts in #marketing-drafts by EOD. :rocket:

jamie.marketing: perfect. final checklist before rollout: landing ready, variants uploaded to experiment platform, segment rule live, amplitude funnel events in, eval harness running, launch-bot reminder. Ping here when done. :thumbsup:
